mentions.name: TypeQuicker
mentions.description: A web-based typing practice platform offering code typing practice in any language, SmartPractice (analyzes history stats to find weak areas and generate targeted exercises), TargetPractice (interactive stats drill-down that creates practice texts targeting specific bigrams), TypeAnything (AI-generated typing exercises on any topic), per-character, per-sequence, per-word, and per-finger speed/accuracy analytics, real-time hand/finger placement indicators, and support for QWERTY, QWERTZ (German), and British ISO keyboard layouts with Dvorak and Colemak planned.

mentions.name: TypeQuicker
mentions.description: A data-driven, personalized typing application that analyzes key weak points in a user's typing and uses LLMs to generate natural text targeting multiple weak points at once. It offers multiple typing modes, including code typing practice supporting 20+ programming languages, a daily typing test, and target practice where clicking any result stat generates natural text using that element (bigrams, trigrams, words, fingers, etc.).
mentions.problem: Help people improve their typing speed quickly with an effective, personalized typing application.
mentions.audience: People who want to improve their typing speed quickly, including those who want to practice typing code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building the most effective typing application

https://typequicker.com

This is something that started as a passion project - I wanted to see just how effective of a typing application I could make to help people improve typing speed quickly.

It’s very data driven and personalized. We analyze a lot of key weak points about a user’s typing and generate natural text (using LLMs) that target multiple key weak points at once.
